findings.name: The Ottawa Pinball Arcade / The Neighbourhood Pub
findings.evidence_quote: The Ottawa Pinball Arcade has grown! ... Experience Social ... 250 Greenbank Road near Hunt Club. Ottawa Citizen (Apr 2026): Loftus' arcade is currently located on Baseline Road... working to transform the former Brass Monkey... new name Experience Social.
findings.note: Baseline Rd / Neighbourhood Pub listing is the old address. Operator relocated to Experience Social (250 Greenbank Rd). New venue markets pinball plus classic arcade and unspecified dance/rhythm games; do not attach new lineup to this sid. Treat Baseline entry as closed/moved.

findings.name: The Storehouse Bar & Grill

findings.note: Iqaluit bar still operating (2025 WS coverage). Positive description is pool/ping pong/pinball/TV sports only; no rhythm cabinet evidence.

findings.name: The Sweet Spot Victoriaville
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv still lists In the Groove 2, but comments (emmanu888, ~2 months before 2026-08-04): Welp! The dedicab is just gone... earlier: the person that owns the games there put the ITG2 up for sale. Facebook Jeux Musical Victoriaville (2024-06-30) had confirmed ITG3 conversion when it was present.
findings.note: Only tracked music cab (ITG dedicab) sold/removed ~mid-2026. Remaining floor is non-music (fighters/racers/shooters, many off). Not has_games unless cab returns.

findings.name: TimeOut Arcade at Centre Eaton de Montréal

findings.note: Explicit ZIv note No DDR or PIU plus non-music inventory. Still part of Time Out Market Montreal food hall arcade.

findings.name: Toybox Cranes @ Pacific Mall

Current games: Hot Wheels, Super Bikes 3, Jurassic Park Arcade, Raccoon Rampage, Big Bass Wheel, Coconut Bash, Grand Piano Keys, Quik Drop, Lane Master XTREME.
findings.note: Former Playscape/FUNtime music destination; now claw/redemption only. Music games positively removed from tracking.

findings.name: University of Waterloo DDR Club

findings.note: Club/meetup stub with zero campus machines. Not a public arcade; players redirected to Pin Up Arcade Bar (separate venue).

findings.name: VicVR

findings.note: If still open would be headset VR only (not map rhythm cabs). Dead site + 2017 ZIv may mean closed, but no hard closure notice found; leave unknown.

findings.name: Xeroz arcade bar

findings.note: ITG2 maps to slug other per project. Primarily pinball/classic bar; ITG is the tracked music cab. No official Konami/SEGA rhythm titles found.
